properties.description: Cut 2026-09-12 on Anthony's word, after increments 430–439 and the lessons-to-graph PR (#472–#493, 22 merges since v0.58.0). The first release whose schema stamp moves by an ENUM VALUE — Decision.status gains `deferred` — which an older binary cannot see; the upgrade note says so. Ships: a session serves the release binary; the server keeps the export current (--export-to); the version guard refuses by name; every required parameter described and every tool findable by a user's words; /feedback (server-kept usage ledger, usage_report, the feedback skill); lessons served at the step (steps on rules and facts; get_skill and the tool list deliver them); plan_epoch no longer resets an arrived epoch; rmcp 3.3.0.
